About me

## I'm a GIS analyst passionate about using geospatial data to better understand our changing environment.

I work with geospatial data to explore environmental and sustainability-related
questions, from satellite image interpretation and land cover mapping to spatial
analysis and data visualization.

I enjoy turning raw spatial data into clear, useful information, and
experimenting with different tools and workflows to solve GIS problems.
